title: Questions about posting games on this site

posts.author: Gean
posts.body:
Greetings!
A long time ago I made a joke game with my sister, it must be more than 6 years ago maybe. I made it in RPG Maker VX Ace, and I wanted to know if I can post it here, but this site has some rules and I don't want to risk breaking any by mistake lol.
The game is one of those made more for the joke and to test some mechanics I was looking at at the time. The game is in Portuguese, has some copyrighted music, and features the members of BTS as protagonists lol. I don't intend to sell this game or profit from it in any way. I just wanted to keep it saved here, because even though it was made as a meme, it was my first finished project.
Would there be any problem posting it here? If so, what's the best way?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: You can't post games with stolen stuff on here.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: If you don't own the license to the assets or characters used in the game you can't post it here.

posts.author: Gean
posts.body:
SGHarlekin said:
You can't post games with stolen stuff on here.
Click to expand...
Thank you for the clarification.
I was kind of expecting something like that. I asked precisely for that reason; I wouldn't say my game has "stolen" content, but there could be a lot of legal red tape, precisely because of the use of images of celebrities.
Note: The post implied they were their songs, but they aren't. Thinking about it now, it's even worse; it was the Overworld 1 song from Super Mario Bros. 3, but a sung version, lol. It would be a small step for Big N to sue me.

Call it stolen, call it pirated, call it copyright infringement. (even if it was a sung version of a copyrighted material, you still "stole" it from whoever made it without having any rights to it). Point being you can't post a game with assets you don't own the rights to. (Obviously)
This is an official forum after all.
